newsitem.title: UK: UK Captain oilfield now due onstream Jan 24-26.
newsitem.headline: UK Captain oilfield now due onstream Jan 24-26.

text.p: Texaco Inc's new British oilfield development Captain is now scheduled to come onstream at the end of January, a company spokeswoman said on Friday.

First production from the 350 million barrel field is now set for January 24-26 after being delayed from the end of last year following an accident at the Spanish shipyard where the field's floating production and storage vessel is being built.
Captain will pump heavy 20 degree API crude and is due to reach peak production of 60,000 barrels per day (bpd) in mid-1997.
Shuttle tankers will carry the crude either direct to local refineries or for reloading at Scotland's Nigg Bay.
